results.summary: rk-git and rk-store are the strongest part of the codebase: about 12k lines of source and 14k lines of tests (257 test functions), with no unsafe code and effectively no unwrap, expect or panic in production code. The git store, trailer write path, reconcile, landing, run worktrees and the render/write/read path are all implemented, wired into the CLI and kernel, and covered by real-git and real-SQLite integration tests with type-level (trybuild) guards. The main gaps are the orphaned-anchor / rewrite-event subsystem (AC-167, 169, 170, 171, 190), which has no producer and no scheduled stage, and gix being used for only three narrow reads while history and common-dir reads shell out to git. Quality debt is concentrated in operator-facing errors (`GitError` has no Display, so failures print Debug with stderr as byte arrays), a few silent-coercion guards (`identity::read`), dead duplicate helpers that rk-cli re-implemented worse, a 2.9k-line `worktree.rs`, and heavy provenance noise and stale module docs in comments. Grade B overall (rk-git about B+, rk-store B), about 85% complete against what Phase 1 asks of this area.
